(R-Ky.) announced he will force a House vote on withdrawing U.S. forces from Iran before his term ends, pressing a war that began in February.
I’ll be forcing a vote to END THE WAR in Iran before my term is up.
Massie had introduced a resolution earlier in the week, H. Con. Res. 126, which was filed Nov. 10 and referred to the House Foreign Affairs Committee, according to the bill text.
Iran War Powers Resolution Directs Removal of US Forces
The concurrent resolution invokes Section 5(c) of the 1973 War Powers Resolution. It directs the president to remove U.S. forces from hostilities against Iran.

It exempts forces needed to defend the United States or an ally from imminent attack. Congress could override the directive with a declaration of war or a specific authorization for use of military force.
House Vote Timing Remains Uncertain
No vote has been scheduled or confirmed. Massie told Fox News Digital one could reach the floor within a few legislative days or around Christmas.
The House has already passed similar Iran War Powers resolutions three times, in June, July and September, although those measures have not resulted in an end to U.S. involvement in the conflict.
